About Me

I’m Yoann Pull, a PhD candidate in Economics at the Laboratoire d’Économie d’Orléans (LEO), University of Orléans, and a quantitative researcher at Square Management. I am doing my PhD under the supervision of Professor Christophe Hurlin. I develop robust econometric and machine-learning methods to measure new and emerging risks in credit risk. I have taught courses at the University of Orléans, the University of Bordeaux, and ENSAI.

On this site you’ll find my research papers and some teaching resources. You can also download my CV (PDF) and find ways to reach me on the contact page.

Research interests: financial econometrics; machine learning; credit risk; alternative data; emerging risks.
